summary: A split dialog sized 66vw by 88svh with a 2fr/3fr column ratio that goes full screen under 600px: a map column beside a details column with a Close button.
use: Wide detail dialogs (map + details, media + form) that need their own box and column ratio and must fill the screen on phones.
spec: Two direct children: `<div class="map">` labelled Map and `<div class="details">` with a name and a filled Close `<Button variant="filled" onclick={() => (open = false)}>`
